description.narrative: CFCDA is a community organisation located in a margilinsed area in Rafat, Salift in the WB. The organisation aims to economically and psychologically empower women in the village of Rafat and surrounding villages through innovative projectsThe initiative sought to economically and psychologically empower women in Rafat and its neighbouring villages through an innovative program cantered on training women in the craft of Western-style confectionaries. This training addressed a significant demand from women who have shown a strong desire to acquire this skill to establish small home-based enterprises, thus enhancing their living conditions.The initiative also offered psychological and social support to the women involved by organizing awareness workshops concurrently with the confectionaries’ training. To facilitate this, CFCDA engaged a social psychologist to provide the essential support, assisting the women in overcoming the challenges posed by domestic and societal violence they encounter.
